sources.title: IT: BERT Pre-Training of Image Transformers - arXiv.org
sources.snippet: Abstract We introduce a self-supervised vision representation model BEIT, which stands for Bidirectional Encoder representation from Image Transformers. Following BERT [DCLT19] developed in the natural language processing area, we propose a masked image modeling task to pretrain vision Transformers.
